# Dialog

A `Dialog` is a layer above all content, requesting information or an additional action.
See [Modal guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/modal/design/)

All props of the <LinkTo kind="Components/Modal" story="basic">Modal</LinkTo> component are also available.

<Source code="import { Dialog } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Primary />

<Controls />

* Any other props supplied will be provided to the <LinkTo kind="Components/Modal" story="basic">Modal</LinkTo> component
* For details on CSS styles, see [CSS implementation](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/blob/develop/packages/styles/src/elements/Dialog/index.ts)
